title: Sound Speed Action: Movies, TV & Streaming Reviews
author: Sohrab Amid-Hozour
description: Sound Speed Action is a film and TV review podcast hosted by Sohrab Amid-Hozour. Since 2022, the show has blended movie reviews, entertainment-industry deep dives, and viewing recommendations spanning new releases and timeless favorites. Special episodes cover major industry events, from the 2023 American film industry strikes to the business of film. New episodes every month. soundspeedactionpod.com
